title: Flex bundle pricing behind a percentage rollout
name: Flex fare rollout

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code decides which users get the flex_bundle_pricing flag? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
An operator sets flex_bundle_pricing to enabled with percentage 0 but adds user u-42 to allowUserIds. u-42 searches from a market listed in denyMarkets. What does isEnabled return for u-42?
choices: false, because denyMarkets is checked before percentage
true, because the allow list is checked before the market deny list
It throws because percentage 0 is invalid

questions.prompt: An operator flips flex_bundle_pricing from enabled to disabled (via replaceRules) between a user's search and their confirmOffer call. What happens to a user who was shown a flex offer?
choices: They are charged the saved flex total without any check
confirmOffer silently converts the offer to standard pricing
confirmOffer throws "pricing changed" and the user must search again
The saved offers are deleted from the QuoteStore

questions.prompt: Why does bucket() hash the flag name together with the user ID rather than hashing only the user ID?
choices: So that different flags at the same percentage roll out to different subsets of users
So that the hash is shorter and faster to compute
So that a disabled flag always produces bucket 0
So that the rollout percentage can exceed 100
